backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (Hotel, HomeStay, Booking, etc.) and in-memory maps for storage, with role-based access control, session management, and helper functions for admin/partner authentication.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs and titles to the frontend/backend files and components that implement them, along with test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of every frontend source file, used as a reference for build planning and documentation.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the React app titled 'Mantralayam Hotel Room Booking App', mounting the app into a div#root and loading the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with all application routes, QueryClient provider, ThemeProvider, LanguageProvider, inactivity timeout handling for customer sessions, and the root layout with Header, Footer, and auxiliary widgets.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminRoomM: Admin panel component for managing homestay/room listings, supporting create, update, and delete operations with partner profile registration and form state management.
frontend/src/components/admin/BookingMan: Admin component that displays booking statistics and a list of all bookings with status badges, and embeds the CustomerManagement component in a tabbed layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/CustomerMa: Admin component for viewing, searching, editing, and deleting customers, with CSV export/copy functionality and Google Sheets URL configuration.
frontend/src/components/admin/HomeStayMa: Admin component for managing homestay listings with full CRUD support, optional passcode, partner profile registration, and photo/amenity fields via a form dialog.
frontend/src/components/admin/HotelManag: Admin component for managing hotels, providing a dialog-based UI to create, edit, and delete hotel records including name, address, description, amenities, and photo uploads via ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/admin/IssuesMana: Admin component that displays and manages reported issues from localStorage, allowing admins to toggle issue status between open/resolved and delete issues, with summary stat cards.
frontend/src/components/admin/Notificati: Admin notification panel that merges backend notifications with persistent localStorage notifications, grouped by category (bookings, payments, partner, logins, issues) with collapsible sections and delete controls.
frontend/src/components/admin/PasscodeMa: Admin component for managing room passcodes, supporting adding and deleting passcodes via the backend actor while syncing changes to localStorage and invalidating relevant React Query caches.
frontend/src/components/admin/ReportsExp: Admin report export component that generates and downloads HTML/PDF reports for bookings and properties, supporting filters by date range, individual customer, or all customers.
frontend/src/components/admin/ReviewMana: Admin component for viewing, searching, filtering, and deleting customer reviews, displaying stats like total reviews, star distribution, and average rating.
frontend/src/components/admin/SMSNotific: Admin panel that displays SMS notification history and statistics (total, sent, pending, failed) for booking confirmations sent to room owners, polling for updates every 10 seconds.
frontend/src/components/admin/TempleSpec: Admin component for managing temple special updates with image URLs, descriptions, and timestamps, supporting add/edit/delete/reorder operations and a preview dialog.
frontend/src/components/AIChatWidget.tsx: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a future AI chat widget component.
frontend/src/components/CustomerInfoModa: Modal dialog that collects a customer's full name and phone number before proceeding with a booking, with basic validation and saffron-themed styling.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Minimal footer component rendering a centered copyright notice with a blurred muted background.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header with links, theme toggle, language selector, and logout handlers for customer, partner, and admin authentication states.
frontend/src/components/HelpFAQWidget.ts: Floating FAQ widget with a searchable list of predefined Q&A items about booking, payments, amenities, and temple timings.
frontend/src/components/LanguageProvider: React context provider that manages the active language state and exposes a translation helper function `t` to child components.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a shared Header, Footer, and a router Outlet for page content.
frontend/src/components/OfflineIndicator: Fixed badge overlay that detects online/offline status and shows a syncing indicator when pending local data needs to be synchronized.
frontend/src/components/partner/PayoutTr: Partner-facing component that tracks earnings, pending balances, and payout records for a specific homestay, allowing partners to request payouts and view monthly earnings history.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated Internet Identity users without a profile to enter their name before proceeding.
frontend/src/components/ReportIssueDialo: Dialog form for submitting categorized issue reports tied to a booking or property, which saves the issue and creates an admin notification.
frontend/src/components/ReviewSection.ts: Component that displays average star ratings and a list of reviews for a homestay, and allows verified customers to submit or admins to delete reviews.
Wrapper component that applies fade-in/fade-out CSS transition animations between route changes using TanStack Router's location.
frontend/src/components/TimeoutReviewPro: A dialog component shown after session timeout that prompts users to submit a star rating and optional feedback, saving the response as an issue and a permanent notification.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, returning an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
Custom React hook that triggers a callback after 30 minutes of user inactivity, with rate limiting to prevent the timeout prompt from appearing more than once per 24 hours.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing login/logout state via DFINITY's AuthClient and exposing identity, login status, and login/clear functions to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useNotificationToasts: A React hook that listens for custom 'newNotification' window events and displays deduplicated toast notifications with category-specific emojis using the Sonner library.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profiles, admin auth, bookings, hotels, homestays, and notifications, with centralized session-error handling and toast feedback.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that configures Tailwind CSS and defines a saffron-gold Hindu-inspired design system with CSS custom properties for both light and dark modes, plus utility classes for glassmorphic effects and gradients.
frontend/src/lib/analytics.ts: localStorage-based analytics module that tracks and persists visitor, booking, payment, and partner activity metrics, dispatching an 'analyticsUpdated' event on changes.
frontend/src/lib/customerCsvExport.ts: Utility module for exporting customer data as CSV, supporting file download and clipboard copy with proper field escaping and date formatting.
frontend/src/lib/customerStorage.ts: localStorage CRUD module for customer records, using phone-number-derived deterministic IDs, supporting upsert, search, and dispatching 'customersUpdated' events on changes.
frontend/src/lib/dataStorage.ts: Core localStorage data management module (schema v4.4) defining types and seed data for homestays, hotels, bookings, notifications, analytics, and temple specials, with versioned migration support.
frontend/src/lib/googleSheetsConfigStora: localStorage module for persisting and retrieving a Google Sheets URL configuration, dispatching 'googleSheetsConfigUpdated' events on save or clear.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Lightweight i18n module supporting English, Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, and Hindi with a translation dictionary covering navigation, browse, booking, and room detail UI strings.
frontend/src/lib/invoicePrint.ts: Generates a printable/PDF-saveable HTML invoice string for a given booking, including styled sections for booking details, dates, and a print button.
frontend/src/lib/issueStorage.ts: Manages issue reports in localStorage, providing CRUD operations (create, load, update status, delete) for user-submitted support issues.
frontend/src/lib/notificationStorage.ts: Handles permanent admin notifications stored in localStorage, supporting add, delete, category filtering, and count operations with custom DOM events for real-time updates.
frontend/src/lib/reviewStorage.ts: Manages homestay reviews in localStorage with functions to add, delete, retrieve, and compute average ratings, plus a check to prevent duplicate reviews per booking.
frontend/src/lib/roomStorage.ts: Frontend localStorage module for managing room/partner data, including CRUD operations for rooms, passcode updates, partner auth cache management, and sync utilities.
frontend/src/lib/smsNotifications.ts: Simulates SMS booking notifications to room owners by storing notification logs in localStorage, with helpers for retrieval, filtering, statistics, and cleanup of old records.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminAppPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with password-protected login, tabs for managing hotels, homestays, bookings, passcodes, notifications, and temple specials, plus an analytics overview and theme toggle.
frontend/src/pages/BookingConfirmationPa: Displays a booking confirmation screen by fetching a booking by ID from local storage and showing details like hotel, homestay, check-in/out times, guests, and total price.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Booking form page that lets a verified customer select check-in date/time, number of rooms, and guests for a specific homestay, calculates a 12-hour fixed price, and submits the booking.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseRoomsPage.tsx: Room browsing page that fetches available homestays, displays them as filterable/searchable cards with amenities and ratings, and triggers a customer info modal before navigating to booking.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerLoginPage.tsx: Customer login page that uses Internet Identity for authentication and prompts new users to enter their name to complete profile creation before redirecting to the room browsing page.
frontend/src/pages/DownloadCenterPage.ts: Renders a static Download Center page displaying project overview, file structure, technology stack, and setup instructions for the Mantralayam Room Booking System.
frontend/src/pages/DownloadProjectPage.t: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page featuring a temple specials carousel with auto-rotation, nearby landmarks with Google Maps links, and navigation buttons for browsing rooms, with authentication-aware UI.
frontend/src/pages/MyBookingsPage.tsx: Displays a user's booking history sorted by date, with options to cancel bookings (with confirmation dialog) and print invoices, persisting changes to localStorage and firing notifications.
frontend/src/pages/NotificationsPage.tsx: Shows all persistent system notifications grouped by category (bookings, payments, partner, logins, issues) with summary count cards and timestamped entries loaded from notificationStorage.
Partner dashboard page that lists the authenticated partner's rooms as editable cards, allowing inline price and availability updates via TanStack Query hooks, with session-error handling and logout support.
frontend/src/pages/PartnerLoginPage.tsx: Renders a password-based login form for partners, authenticates via the backend actor, stores a session in localStorage, and navigates to the partner dashboard on success.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Empty file with no content; placeholder for a payment failure page.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Empty file with no content; placeholder for a payment success page.
frontend/src/pages/RoomDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single room including a photo carousel, amenities, ratings, and location, fetched via the useGetHomeStayDetails hook with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/RoomSearchPage.tsx: Empty file with no content; placeholder for a room search page.
frontend/src/pages/StandaloneRoomSearchP: Empty file with no content; placeholder for a standalone room search page.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, box shadows, and animations, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state, existing implemented features, pending feature requests, known issues, and architectural notes for the ICP-based homestay management app.
